notes: Paper: NanoFilt v2.7.1 -l 1000 -q 10. Filtlong --min_length 1000 --min_mean_q 90 applies the same two thresholds (NanoFilt's ave_qual is -10*log10 of the mean per-base error probability; Filtlong's mean quality is 100 * mean per-base accuracy; Q10 = 90 %).
